title: 🔍 Visualize your AL objects in a tree view, filter and navigate directly in VS Code
summary: AL Object Visualizer is a VS Code extension that displays AL objects in a filterable tree view with customizable badges and colors, helping developers navigate and manage multiple files across projects efficiently.
key_points: Automatically decorates AL files with Unicode badges and colors in the Explorer based on object type
Groups all workspace objects by type in a statistics panel with configurable folder nesting levels
Supports real-time text and regex filtering to quickly locate specific AL objects
Allows direct file opening from filtered results and provides quick picker selection by object type
features: Explorer decorations with badges and colors

quotes.text: displays all AL objects classified by type in a tree, decorates them with Unicode badges and colors to identify them at a glance
quotes.why_it_matters: Core feature enabling quick visual identification of object types across large workspaces
